summary: Verified all 25 sources and all 142 evidence items in data/research/equipment.json against fetched primary documents (SEC 10-Ks/20-F retrieved via direct sec.gov fetch and, where SEC's automated-tool filter blocked that, via Wayback Machine copies of sec.gov obtained with the same declared, non-impersonating User-Agent; company web/PDF sources fetched directly). Entity verdicts: 61 publish, 18 publish_flagged, 0 reject (of 79 entities: 18 companies, 34 facilities, 12 flows, 15 financial_links; no controls in this layer). Evidence verdicts: 128 verified, 13 unreachable, 1 quote_not_found, 0 verified_with_correction (of 142 total). TRUMPF (the analyst's top concern): all 3 sources and all 5 evidence items check out exactly once fetched from the Wayback Machine's archived copies of trumpf.com (trumpf.com itself returns HTTP 403 to any automated fetch, honest User-Agent or not); the earlier concern about an unchecked summarizing tool is resolved. KLA's China-revenue quote, cut at a page break ('...2025 and'), is confirmed contiguous in the source once the inserted running header ('12 Table of Contents') is discounted — acceptable per instructions. Table-row quotes (AMAT/Teradyne/FormFactor/Ichor/TEL geographic and customer tables) all matched after normalizing whitespace/hyphenation artifacts introduced by HTML/PDF-to-text conversion, never by changing the substance of a quote. Two real problems found beyond the analyst's own flags: (1) flow:zeiss-oberkochen-to-asml-veldhoven and flow:zeiss-wetzlar-to-asml-veldhoven were labeled 'documented' but the evidence only documents the Zeiss-ASML supply relationship, not that output ships specifically to the Veldhoven facility (which is deduced, exactly like the sibling San Diego/Wilton/Berlin-to-Veldhoven flows the analyst correctly labeled 'inferred') — corrected basis to 'inferred' with an inference_note and set to publish_flagged. (2) co:tokyo-electron's quarterly China-revenue evidence ('China 259.1 277.0 233.9...') is not a real quote: it concatenates individual data-label numbers read off two separate bar charts rather than quoting a table row; marked quote_not_found and the company flagged (existence/HQ is otherwise solid and this figure isn't relied on by any financial_link). Systemic gap: two sources — Applied Materials' FY2025 10-K and Ultra Clean Holdings' FY2025 10-K — could not be retrieved this session despite direct sec.gov attempts (declared User-Agent), Wayback Machine lookups, and IR-site attempts; SEC's data.sec.gov submissions API confirms both filings exist with the cited accession numbers/dates, but body text is unconfirmed. This leaves co:applied-materials' FY2025-specific China-revenue/customer-concentration figures, and essentially all of co:ultra-clean and its two flows (UCT->Lam, UCT->AMAT) and one flow (UCT->ASML) plus two financial_links (Lam->UCT, AMAT->UCT) unverified and flagged pending re-fetch — recommend a follow-up counsel pass once SEC access is available, or the analyst supplying a saved copy of these two filings. AMAT's HQ/existence is independently corroborated via the (reachable) FY2024 10-K, so only the FY2025-specific percentages are actually in doubt for that company. Applied Materials' Austin/Gloucester/Rehovot (and, less severely, Singapore) site-level facilities are sourced only to the FY2023 10-K; FY2024/FY2025 10-Ks list manufacturing by country only and no longer name these cities — flagged as stale per the analyst's own gap note, not rejected, since nothing contradicts them. Revenue-concentration financial_links were checked individually for exact percentage/fiscal-year match and for whether the description names a customer the filing itself leaves unnamed: all 15 check out — the four Lam Research customer-concentration links (Micron/Samsung/SK hynix/TSMC) correctly avoid attributing Lam's unattributed 16/15/12/12% figures to any specific named customer, and every other link's named customer and percentage/amount matches its filing exactly. No controls in this layer (controls[] is empty in the research file) and no Tier 3/news sources were used anywhere, so no insufficient_tier findings. Rejected ids: none — every problem found could be fixed with a correction, a flag, or was a genuine retrieval gap rather than a false or unsupported claim.
